title: Area operators on Hardy spaces of Dirichlet series II: counterexamples and compactness criteria
summary: We study area operators $\mathbb{A}_{μ,l}$, $0<l<\infty$, induced by positive Borel measures on the right half-plane and acting on the Hardy spaces of Dirichlet series $\mathscr H^p$, $0<p<\infty$. We first disprove a conjecture proposed by the present authors in an earlier work by constructing a probability measure, valid for all $0<p,l<\infty$, for which the associated area operator is bounded although the measure fails the proposed Carleson conditions.
